title: Harnessing thiazole chemistry for antifungal strategies through an experimental and computational chemistry approach: anti-biofilm, molecular docking, dynamics, and DFT analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21838-21858
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00657K, Paper

Rahul A. Shinde, Vishnu A. Adole, Rajendra H. Patil, Bhushan B. Khairnar, Bapu S. Jagdale, Tahani Mazyad Almutairi, Harun Patel, Mohammad Shahidul Islam, Iqrar Ahmad, A. Ram Kumar, S. Selvaraj, Thansing B. Pawar, Mahboob Alam
This study reports the design, synthesis, and evaluation of four novel (E)-2-(2-(1-(5-chlorothiophen-2-yl)ethylidene)hydrazineyl)-4-(aryl)thiazole derivatives (4a–4d) as potential anti-biofilm agents against Candida albicans.
